newsitem.title: USA: Lowe & Partners wins Roche Xenical account.
newsitem.headline: Lowe & Partners wins Roche Xenical account.

text.p: Lowe & Partners/SMS, owned by a unit of Interpublic Group of Cos Inc, said Monday it had won the account for Xenical, an anti-obesity drug from Roche Laboratories.
The value of the account was not disclosed.

Lowe & Partners/SMS spokesman Michael Draznin said the company will handle advertising, communications and direct marketing that targets healthcare professionals, managed care organizations and general consumers for Roche.

Xenical is a prescription drug that blocks the absorption of fat in the intestine, Draznin said. Clinical tests have been completed, and the drug is awaiting Food and Drug Administration approval, Draznin said.
